'''Tuandha''' is a ''[[Far Dareis Mai]]''.

== Appearance ==
She is tall and has lost her right eye. She has a thick scar on the right-hand side which pulls one side of her mouth up in a half smile.

== Activities ==
She is part of [[Perrin Aybara]]'s army that goes into [[Ghealdan]].

She is one of the Maidens who meet Perrin when he sets out to view the [[Shaido]] camped in [[Malden]].
